summary: 47-year-old Salvadore Garcia-Atance killed in a snowboarder-released avalanche Tuesday morning in the Tempter couloir of Bear Creek Preserve, Telluride; slide ran about 75 ft wide leaving a debris field 300 ft long and 15-20 ft deep; Tuesday ground search with avalanche dog teams found nothing; dozens of SAR volunteers, Telluride Ski Patrol, avalanche dogs, and Helitrax helicopters resumed Wednesday, locating his body by probe line ~11:30 a.m. near the creek above the boulder at the top of the Bear Creek trail
location: Tempter couloir, Bear Creek Preserve, Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue; Telluride Ski Patrol; Telluride Helitrax
notes: Recorded at the avalanche/incident date 2019-02-19 (Tuesday); body recovered 2019-02-20 CAIC classic 2018-19 table describes the same slide as also catching a sidecountry rider ('1 sidecountry rider caught, 1 backcountry skier caught, buried, and killed'); the row counts only the deceased subject.
